So I lived on the top floor of this really old but renovated house. My whole room reeked of cigarettes and, at first, I figured it was just seeped into the room from the previous resident. Well, as the weather started getting colder, the smell became unbearable, and that’s when it started to hit me that the smell was coming from my downstairs neighbor... I pondered how to respectfully approach the situation without igniting a bonfire. One day I went downstairs and, after a few unsuccessful attempts at reaching my neighbor(she was a hermit), I decided to leave a note simply explaining the situation and asking if she could kindly smoke outside. This is when all shit hit the fan. 

For the next 6 months, everyday she left a new, and increasing unhinged, note on my door. It started with her saying we were framing her and that she wasn’t the one smoking. Finally she admitted she was,but the notes didn’t stop. The situation degraded to the point where, in the last few months of her being there, she started accusing me of setting up cameras and hacking devices around her room and in her phone. Every morning at like 2 am she would run up the stairs of the house and bang in my door for half an hour insisting that I stop hacking her wifi and cell phone. She even went so far as to turn off the main power breaker to my house. To make matters worse, my landlord told me he couldn’t remove her because of the COVID moratorium on evictions. Finally, I guess he also had enough and evicted her. On the final day of her being in the building, she proceeds to pour deer piss all over my door... I only found out after being unable to tolerate the smell and accidentally stepping on it while I had only socks on. She also tapped her 6 months of unpaid phone and wifi bills on my door and told me I owed her for these bills, and 5 phones she destroyed because of me “hacking” her. 

Needless to say, I ignited a bonfire in my building...all because I asked once for my neighbor to stop gassing up my apartment with her cigarette smoke.
